tier_order_note: Group choice first: the download group wins whenever it is a non-empty dict, otherwise the stream group. Key order inside the chosen group: flac > mp33 > mp32 > mp3 > ogg, mapped flac/Flac/Lossless, mp33/Mp3/High, mp32/Mp3/High, mp3/Mp3/Low, ogg/Ogg/Low (voicefox/source/src/jamendo/mod.rs:133-154).

cases.note: Lossless-first: the flac key beats mp3 regardless of dict order (upstream inline golden mod.rs:528-547).
An empty download dict falls back to the stream group; mp32 outranks ogg (upstream inline golden mod.rs:528-547).
mp33 outranks ogg and maps to Mp3/High (the 320k label follows the upstream quality tag and the mp33 URL naming convention; no bitrate was ever measured for this tier, 2026-11-18 audit gap).

Real-form capture, trackid 1538710 (2026-11-18): the download group wins, so the /download/track/1538710/mp32/ URL is selected, NOT the stream group's format=mp31 URL. Measured bitrates: /mp32/ is 192k VBR, format=mp31 is 96k, so the mp3 key's Low label is approximate while the /mp32/ URL is the better stream. Only the URL shape is pinned here; the from= token values have unknown validity and must not be pinned.
Upstream trap kept verbatim: a non-empty download dict that contains none of the five known keys returns None and does NOT fall back to the stream group (mod.rs:133-154).
